words.ex: Our new client is from the UK.
words.exRo: Noul nostru client este din Regatul Unit.

words.ex: English is the language of our team.
words.exRo: Engleza este limba echipei noastre.

words.ex: Is your boss British? No, he isn't. He's Irish.
words.exRo: Șeful tău e britanic? Nu, nu e. E irlandez.

words.ex: Is your client American or British?

words.ex: Is this car German? Yes, it's a BMW.

words.ex: We often eat at a Spanish restaurant.
words.exRo: Mâncăm des la un restaurant spaniol.

words.ex: Paris is the capital of France.

words.ex: My colleague Claire is French, from Lyon.
words.exRo: Colega mea Claire este franțuzoaică, din Lyon.

words.ex: Where are you from? I'm from Romania.

words.ex: I live in Cluj with my wife.

words.ex: PHP is my favourite programming language.

words.ex: Age is not important in our team.

words.ex: The ticket is one hundred euros.

words.ex: The website has five thousand users.
words.exRo: Site-ul are cinci mii de utilizatori.

words.ex: Is there a new email from the client?

words.ex: My phone isn't in my bag. Where is it?

words.ex: Please call me after five o'clock.
words.exRo: Te rog să mă suni după ora cinci.

words.ex: My surname is long. It has nine letters.
words.exRo: Numele meu de familie e lung. Are nouă litere.

words.ex: Can you spell your surname, please?
words.exRo: Puteți să vă spuneți numele de familie pe litere, vă rog?

words.ex: My first name is Ioana, and my surname is Pop.
words.exRo: Prenumele meu este Ioana, iar numele de familie este Pop.

words.ex: Where is the meeting room, please?
words.exRo: Unde este sala de ședințe, vă rog?

words.exRo: Bună, care este adresa ta de e-mail, te rog?

words.ex: Who is the new project manager?

words.ex: How old is your son? He's six.
words.exRo: Câți ani are fiul tău? Are șase ani.

words.ex: Our clients are from all over the world.
words.exRo: Clienții noștri sunt din toată lumea.

words.ex: Is this the right address? Yes, it is.
words.exRo: Aceasta este adresa corectă? Da, este.

words.ex: Sorry, this phone number is wrong.
words.exRo: Scuze, numărul ăsta de telefon e greșit.

words.ex: Sorry, can you say that again, please?
words.exRo: Scuze, puteți repeta, vă rog?

words.ex: Ask Mihai. He knows the answer.
words.exRo: Întreabă-l pe Mihai. El știe răspunsul.

words.ex: Please answer the client's email today.
words.exRo: Te rog să răspunzi azi la e-mailul clientului.

words.ex: How do you say 'bug' in Romanian?

words.ex: I write all my work emails in English.

words.ex: I read the news on my phone.
words.exRo: Citesc știrile pe telefon.

words.ex: Is Mr Wilson here? No, he isn't.
words.exRo: Domnul Wilson este aici? Nu, nu este.

words.ex: The coffee machine is over there.
words.exRo: Aparatul de cafea este acolo.

words.ex: We are from the same city!
words.exRo: Suntem din același oraș!

words.ex: This book is about the history of Rome.
words.exRo: Cartea aceasta este despre istoria Romei.

words.ex: Here is an example of my code.
words.exRo: Iată un exemplu din codul meu.

words.ex: All the information is on our website.
words.exRo: Toate informațiile sunt pe site-ul nostru.

words.ex: The client's new website is ready.
